title: Quick Crispy Saudi Arabian Chicken Kebabs
description: A winey and crispy weeknight Saudi Arabian dish featuring black pepper and pickle, this recipe is low fat friendly and perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, pickle juice, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the kebabs are baking, mix the white wine vinegar and 1 tablespoon of water in a small bowl.
After the kebabs have baked for 15 minutes, brush them with the vinegar mixture.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
